headline: Romania Halts Its Only Nuclear Power Plant Amid Danube Low Water – Already Begins Importing
summary: The Cernavoda nuclear power plant in Romania has stopped operating because of a significant drop in the Danube's water level. Romania has already started importing electricity.
why: Cernavoda is Romania's only nuclear power station, so an outage forces the country to rely on imports and other generation to meet electricity demand.
